title: Metformin
text: Metformin is an oral medicine commonly used to manage Type 2 diabetes.

title: Hypertension
text: Common medicines used to treat hypertension include thiazide diuretics, calcium channel blockers, ACE inhibitors, and angiotensin receptor blockers.

title: Aspirin
text: Aspirin is a medicine that can be used in certain cardiovascular prevention settings when clinically appropriate.

title: Antibiotic Stewardship
text: Antibiotics are used to treat bacterial infections and are not effective against viral infections.
